tools.name: post_deployment_alert_to_slack
tools.description: Posts a message to a Slack incoming webhook summarizing the replica status of a deployment, so the on-call team is notified.
tools.code:
import requests
from kubernetes import client, config
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def post_deployment_alert_to_slack(namespace: str, deployment: str, webhook_url: str, note: str = "") -> str:
    config.load_kube_config()
    apps = client.AppsV1Api()
    dep = apps.read_namespaced_deployment_status(deployment, namespace)
    st = dep.status
    want = dep.spec.replicas or 0
    ready = st.ready_replicas or 0
    avail = st.available_replicas or 0
    text = (
        f":warning: *{namespace}/{deployment}* has {ready}/{want} ready, "
        f"{avail} available, {st.unavailable_replicas or 0} unavailable."
    )
    if note:
        text += f"\n{note}"
    r = requests.post(webhook_url, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return f"Alert sent ({r.status_code}) for {namespace}/{deployment}"
